about_the_game:
Bound to the Forest

Play as a living mushroom connected to the ancient mycelium, defending the forest’s fragile balance against the creeping corruption. Endless waves of mutated insects close in, each stronger than the last. Adapt, endure, and fight back in this dark-fantasy bullet-hell roguelite survivor.

Grow Stronger Every Run

Defeat enemies to gain experience, level up, and choose from random perk cards that shape your playstyle. Adapt fast, every choice can mean survival or decay.

The Forest Fights With You

Collect mushrooms to awaken the forest’s powers. Roots strike, spores burst, and nature itself fights by your side. Strengthen both yourself and the forest to unleash devastating synergy attacks.

Evolve Your Skills

Morph your abilities into stronger forms or unlock new ones. Every skill path offers unique effects and powerful combinations that drastically change your build.

Face the Corruption

Every few waves, monstrous bosses emerge, twisted creations of poison and decay. Learn their patterns, strike with precision, and cleanse the infection from the forest.

Progress Beyond Death

Unlock new characters, upgrades, and permanent bonuses between runs. Each attempt brings you closer to mastering the forest’s true power.

Co-op Survival

Join forces in online co-op and fight side by side. Share progress, combine abilities, and defend the forest together against the endless swarm.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: 2.8 GHz Dual Core CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 660 or equivalent with 2 GB of video RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: 3.2 GHz Quad Core Processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 960 or equivalent with 4GB of video RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Survive endless waves in this dark-fantasy bullet-hell roguelite survivor. Play as a living mushroom bound to the forest, evolve powerful nature abilities, and fight mutated insects. Collect, grow stronger, and defend the forest solo or together in online co-op.
